view.scene_description: A brightly lit supermarket aisle with colorful hanging decorations like hot air balloons and red lanterns. Shelves are stocked with various products, including boxed goods and fresh produce. Customers browse items, while refrigerated units and promotional posters line the walls. The ceiling has fluorescent lights and visible structural beams.

objects.label: man wearing white shirt
objects.observation: A man in a white long-sleeved shirt with Chinese characters on it is standing near shelves, holding a product. He wears glasses and looks down at items. His position is left-center of the frame, partially obscured by stacked boxes. He stands on the floor, supported by his own legs.

objects.label: woman with dark hair
objects.observation: A woman with dark hair is partially visible behind the man, looking toward the shelves. She is positioned slightly to the right of the man and appears to be browsing. Her face is mostly obscured by the man’s shoulder and the display. She stands on the floor, supported by her own legs.

objects.label: stacked product boxes
objects.observation: Tall stacks of colorful product boxes in pink, green, blue, and white dominate the foreground. They are arranged neatly on shelves and appear to be dairy or beverage products. Some boxes have visible branding. They rest on metal shelving units, supported by their own structure.

objects.label: hanging decorative hot air balloon
objects.observation: A red-and-white striped hot air balloon decoration hangs from the ceiling, located above the central aisle. It is suspended by thin wires or strings, visible against the black ceiling. It is positioned near the center-right of the frame, partially obscuring the view of lights above.

objects.label: red paper lanterns
objects.observation: Several red paper lanterns hang from the ceiling in the middle distance, clustered together. They are suspended by thin wires or strings, visible against the black ceiling. They are positioned above the central aisle, near the refrigerated section, and partially obscure the view of lights above.

objects.label: fluorescent ceiling lights
objects.observation: Multiple long, rectangular fluorescent lights are mounted on the black ceiling, providing bright illumination. They are evenly spaced along the ceiling, running horizontally. They are positioned across the top of the frame, illuminating the entire scene.

objects.label: refrigerated display unit
objects.observation: A red and white refrigerated display unit is located on the right side of the aisle, near the back wall. It contains various beverages and has a glass door. A person is standing in front of it, facing away from the camera. It is mounted to the wall and floor, supported by its own structure.

objects.label: person in dark clothing
objects.observation: A person wearing dark clothing is standing in front of the refrigerated display unit, facing away from the camera. Their posture suggests they are browsing or selecting an item. They stand on the floor, supported by their own legs, and are partially obscured by the display unit.

objects.label: fruit display
objects.observation: A fruit display filled with colorful produce, including purple grapes and other fruits, is located in the middle of the aisle. It is placed on a wooden counter or table, supported by its own structure. It is positioned in front of the refrigerated unit and partially obscured by the person in dark clothing.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: A large promotional poster featuring a young man is displayed on the right wall near the entrance. It has bright colors and Chinese text. It is mounted to the wall, supported by its own structure. It is positioned near the top right corner of the frame, partially obscured by the person in dark clothing.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000006", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
